title: Beef Stew with Mediterranean Twist
description: A hearty German-inspired beef stew with a Mediterranean flair, featuring tender beef and vegetables in a rich broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown beef cubes in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch.
Remove browned beef from pot and set aside.
Add chopped onion to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add chopped carrots and potatoes; cook for 5 minutes.
Add red wine, beef broth, and tomato paste; stir to combine.
Return browned beef to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until beef is tender, about 2 hours.
Stir in chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
